title: Become a Member
intro: Membership supports the Council and provides access to speaker programs, member resources, and discussion groups.

heroImage.alt: WACHH members participating in a community discussion

infoText: Membership offers education, access, and community: learn from influential figures in world affairs and connect with civic, academic, military, and business leaders across our region. Current members can renew their 2026–2027 membership by logging into their account.

reasons.title: Speaker programs
reasons.text: Attend 14 Distinguished Speaker Series programs each season, including two international speakers.

reasons.title: Member resources
reasons.text: Access program livestreams, video archives, newsletters, and selected programs from other World Affairs Councils.

reasons.title: Discussion and community
reasons.text: Participate in Great Decisions and other discussion programs with people interested in international affairs.

reasons.title: Student outreach
reasons.text: Support Academic WorldQuest and Model United Nations through membership, volunteering, or additional gifts.

joinOnlineText: Complete the online membership form and pay by credit card.
joinByMailText: Print the membership form, complete it, and mail it with your check to the Council office.

testimonial.name: Jan Cooper
testimonial.quote: Hilton Head is a vibrant community with a very engaged population. The World Affairs Council of Hilton Head offers the opportunity for individuals to remain educated and up-to-date on world affairs and their impact on the US. It is a small investment of time and dollars that offers an extraordinary return. We are incredibly fortunate to have this jewel in our midst!

title: Attend as a guest
intro: Non-members may register for individual Distinguished Speaker Series programs. WACHH members do not need to register or pay an additional event fee.

heroImage.alt: A WACHH speaker addressing an audience

sectionImage.alt: Guests and members attending a WACHH speaker program

paragraphs: Guests must be registered and wear name tags for admission. Pre-registration and advance online payment saves time at the event but we do accept walk-ins. Please visit the Guest Table in the Gathering Space to register.
We ask that guests arrive at 9:30 am in order to allow sufficient time to check in and enjoy a cup of coffee. Please check in at the Welcome Table at the event for a name badge.

opportunitiesText: Meet new people, share your talents in a meaningful way, and be part of a community. Our programs are run by dedicated volunteer teams who help events operate smoothly. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences; your time commitment can be as much or as little as you can afford.

testimonial.name: Kaye Black
testimonial.quote: WACHH has given me a better understanding of what is happening in the world, and I love learning about the complexity behind the news headlines. World Affairs Council speakers consistently offer unique perspectives on the world’s most pressing international challenges. I can’t think of a better way to stay informed about today’s world order and what it means to us as Americans.

heritageOptions.title: Heritage Champions Fore Charity
heritageOptions.text: Gifts from $1,000 to $10,000 receive an additional 20% from the Heritage Classic Foundation. A $1,000 gift provides $1,200 for WACHH.
heritageOptions.note: Open for donations January 1 through December 1 each year.

heritageOptions.title: Birdies for Charity
heritageOptions.text: Support WACHH during the RBC Heritage by making a fixed contribution or pledging an amount tied to tournament birdies. The Heritage Classic Foundation adds 20% to eligible donations.
heritageOptions.note: 2027 campaign: January 1 through April 18, 2027, the final day of the RBC Heritage.

heritageNote: Heritage Classic Foundation guidelines stipulate that donors receive no tangible benefits in exchange for these contributions.

sponsorshipPhoto.caption: Your support brings world affairs conversations to our community.

photo.alt: A speaker addressing Council members and guests in a full auditorium

sponsorshipParagraphs: The average cost of presenting each of our 12 Distinguished Speakers is approximately $5,000, including facilities, travel, and honorarium. Members can help through an Ambassador sponsorship ($1,000) or Diplomat sponsorship ($500).

Sponsors receive recognition from the podium, on the WACHH website, and in our Annual Report. Sponsors of Distinguished and Global Speakers are invited to lunch or dinner with their speaker and receive recognition and preferred seating at the event.
globalFundText: Each year, WACHH presents two Global Speakers who travel internationally to Hilton Head, at a cost of approximately $10,000 per speaker. Contributions to the Global Speaker Fund may be made through the Community Foundation of the Lowcountry.

monthlyPhoto.caption: Reliable support helps sustain Council programs, including educational opportunities for students.

photo.alt: Student teams and adult organizers gathered for Academic WorldQuest

monthlyText: Recurring gifts provide a reliable, predictable source of support, helping WACHH plan confidently and sustain high-quality programs throughout the year. Even a modest monthly gift adds up. Select Monthly giving in the donation forms below, then choose Monthly under Payment Frequency.
taxIntro: There may be opportunities to support WACHH while also achieving your personal financial and charitable-giving objectives.

taxOptions.title: Qualified Charitable Distributions (QCDs)
taxOptions.text: If you are age 70½ or older, you may be able to make a Qualified Charitable Distribution directly from an eligible IRA to a qualified charitable organization. A properly structured QCD is generally excluded from taxable income and may also count toward an applicable Required Minimum Distribution.

taxOptions.title: Required Minimum Distributions (RMDs)
taxOptions.text: For many current retirees, RMDs begin at age 73, although the applicable starting age can vary based on date of birth. If you are required to take an RMD, an eligible QCD may satisfy all or part of that requirement while supporting a charitable organization.

taxNote: Because individual tax and financial circumstances vary, we encourage you to consult your financial advisor, tax professional, or IRA administrator before making a QCD or other tax-planned charitable gift.

testimonial.name: John Strother
testimonial.quote: I love the World Affairs Council of Hilton Head speakers. Every speaker has incredible expertise in international affairs or government. The speakers and topics are engaging. Their Great Decisions program is a fun way to discuss current events and ideas. Their Book Club makes for great conversations about timely subjects. Several weeks ago, we were fortunate to have the former ambassador to Russia come and join us in discussing his book. Pretty nice to have such an intimate environment with such knowledgeable people.

title: Sponsor a speaker
intro: Speaker sponsorship helps fund the Distinguished Speaker Series. Sponsors are acknowledged at the program, receive preferred seating, and are invited to a meal with the speaker.

heroImage.alt: A WACHH speaker addressing the audience

featurePhoto.caption: Sponsorships help bring 12 national and two international experts to Hilton Head each year. Sponsors receive recognition from the podium, on the WACHH website, and in the Annual Report.

photo.alt: Council audience gathered for a speaker presentation

levels.name: Ambassador Sponsorship
levels.perks: Comes with four tickets to the sponsored presentation and two invitations to a small group speaker dinner on the evening before the presentation.

levels.name: Diplomat Sponsorship
levels.perks: Comes with two tickets to the sponsored presentation and two invitations to the speaker lunch after the program.

becomeParagraphs: Please use the Sponsorship Donation form below to select your sponsorship level. Specify which speaker you would like to sponsor (rank order preferences in case sponsorship slots are already taken).
If you’d like to sponsor more than one speaker presentation, write in the total amount of your payment and make a note in the Sponsorship Comment field.

testimonial.name: Richard Hammes
testimonial.quote: I cannot think of another organization that provides the wide array of speakers on such a broad range of topics as the World Affairs Council of Hilton Head. They bring to our community true experts in their fields that would be impossible to find anywhere else, especially for the cost of this membership. The nuggets of knowledge gained from these experts is why I try to never miss a presentation. Once you come to your first session you will be hooked.
